stages.name: SIC
stages.note: First stage: five F-1; separates at ~2.7 min

stages.name: Interstage
stages.note: S-IC/S-II interstage ring, dropped ~30 s after S-II ignition

stages.name: LES
stages.note: Launch Escape System, jettisoned after S-II ignition

stages.name: SII
stages.note: Second stage: five J-2; separates at ~9 min

stages.name: SIVB
stages.note: Third stage + Instrument Unit: one J-2, restarts for TLI

stages.name: SLA
stages.note: Spacecraft LM Adapter panels, open after TLI

stages.name: ServiceModule
stages.note: Apollo Service Module with the SPS engine
